name: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited
about: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited provides barcoding solutions, Automatic Identification and Data Capture technologies in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Financial Inclusion and Digital Services; Agri Supply Chain and Technologies; and Diagnostics and Healthcare. The Financial Inclusion and Digital Services segment provides access to credit and allied financial products; and rural-focused lending and financial services distribution through an established last-mile network. The Agri Supply Chain and Technologies segment develops agri commerce, trade finance, smart retail and crop advisory capabilities under Project AVIO ecosystem. The Company has entered a strategic partnership with Huwel Lifesciences Private Limited, a molecular diagnostics company developing indigenous and cost-effective diagnostic technologies. In addition, the company offers its services to banks and financial institutions. The company was formerly known as Bartronics India Limited and changed its name to Avio Smart Market Stack Limited in February 2026. Avio Smart Market Stack Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
